name: playground-protoactor.go
description: :balloon: My playground for playing with protoactor (the next gen Actor Model framework) in go, following DDD, Event Sourcing & CQRS paradigms.

paragraphs: My playground I use for playing with fancy and exciting technologies. This one's for experimenting a platform actor in go named protoactor, in which actors follow DDD - Event Sourcing / CQRS principles.

I have a deep-rooted passion for the Actor Model. Having been a big fan and an avid admirer of the Erlang Actor system, its elegance, and efficiency in managing concurrent processes, I've always been intrigued by the power and simplicity it offers.

Erlang's approach to concurrency, fault tolerance, and system distribution has set a high standard in the realm of Actor-based systems. Drawing inspiration from this, I've created this repository as an experimentation to explore these compelling concepts in a different landscape - the world of Go. It's a personal quest to understand how the robustness and versatility of the Actor Model can be harnessed in Go.
features: Minimalistic API - small and easy to understand and use.
Protobuf all the way for maximum performance and interoperability.
